notes: Oliver System 6 seven-digit conversion display check (frpwr_b6, s6_mS6S, fp_7digit_disp). PinMAME labels the two small fp_7digit_disp entries only as left and right side, so this run inserts a coin, starts a game and records which display entry shows the credit count and which shows the ball in play, together with the special-solenoid, flipper-button and lane-change behaviour already recorded for frpwr_l6. Run from an NVRAM initialized by one prior empty-NVRAM power-up.
